output.reply: Thanks for the suggestion! Having dark mode follow your system setting automatically would save you from switching it by hand every evening, and I've passed your request on to our product team.

Hi Maria, thanks for letting us know, and sorry for the trouble with the two $9.99 charges for Lumen Plus on the 3rd. We've passed this to our billing team to review the duplicate charge, and they'll follow up with you about next steps.

Thanks for reporting this. We're sorry that tables pasted from Google Sheets are collapsing into a single line of text in Lumen web on Chrome 131, especially since it worked last week. We've passed this to our team to investigate, and if you can share an example table or a screenshot, it will help us reproduce the problem.

Sorry you've been locked out after your work email change. We can help move your account to your new address once we verify that you own it, so please reply from your new email with your old email address and any recent account details you can share. We'll take it from there and guide you through the next steps.

We're sorry to see a $120 annual plan charge after you cancelled in March, and we understand how frustrating that is. Please reply with your cancellation confirmation email and the date of the charge so our billing team can review your account right away. We'll update you as soon as we've looked into it.

Sorry to hear the iOS app closes when you open notes with attached PDFs, especially with your exam coming up. We've passed this to our team for investigation; could you tell us your iOS version, your Lumen app version, and roughly when the crashes started? In the meantime, you may be able to reach your lecture slides by signing in to Lumen on the web or on another device.

We're sorry Lumen isn't reachable for you and your team right before your presentation, and we've escalated this to our engineering team right away. To help us investigate, please send your workspace name, your approximate location or network, and whether the 'Cannot reach server' error appears on web, desktop and mobile alike. If any notes are already open in a device or browser tab, please keep it open and don't sign out.

Thanks for reaching out, and a backup before your trip is a great idea. We'll follow up shortly with the steps for exporting your notes and the formats available, including whether a bulk Markdown export is supported. In the meantime, let us know if you use the desktop, web or mobile app so we can give you the right instructions.

Thanks for reaching out! To share a notebook, open it, click the Share button, and enter the email addresses of the people you want to invite or copy a share link. You can choose whether each person can view or edit the notebook.

Thank you for reporting this. A login from an unfamiliar location and notebooks shared with an unknown address are serious, so we are escalating your case to our security team right away. In the meantime, please change your password, turn on two-factor authentication if you haven't already, and remove the unknown address from the notebooks' sharing settings.

Thanks for reaching out. We've passed your request on to our billing team so they can prepare an invoice that shows Brandt Logistics GmbH and VAT number DE123456789. They will get back to you by email once it has been issued.
Thanks for flagging this! You're right that the footer word count shows 0 for notes that contain only emoji. I've passed it to our team to look into.

Thanks for letting us know that sync has been stuck on 'Syncing...' for three hours on your phone and laptop, and that search is returning no results. We're looking into both issues, and it would help to know your app versions and whether any recent edits are missing on either device. In the meantime, please don't sign out or reinstall the app so that any unsynced changes stay safe.

Thanks for reaching out! You can usually update your display name in your account or profile settings, and the new name should then appear next to your comments. If the old nickname still shows after you've saved the change, let us know and we'll look into it.

Sorry the new layout made this harder to find. The weekly summary emails can usually be turned off in Settings under the email or notification preferences, and each summary email should also have an unsubscribe link at the bottom. If you can't find the option, reply and let us know which device or app version you're using, and we'll walk you through it.

Thanks for these suggestions: pinning notes to the top of a notebook, a default font size setting, and a longer 60-day trash retention period. I've passed all three on to our product team for consideration.

Thank you for the suggestion. A version history showing who edited a note and when would clearly help a team of 12 working together. I've passed your request, including your interest in paying for it, to our product team for review.

I'm sorry your meeting notes disappeared after the reload, and that this has now happened twice. We've escalated this to our engineering team to investigate the lost content and why today's edits aren't in version history. Could you tell us which device, app version and approximate time this happened so we can look into it?

We're sorry the mobile app is showing 'temporarily unavailable' again, especially after this has happened several Monday mornings in a row. We've passed this to our team to investigate the repeated disruption, and you can follow the latest service status on our status page. If the web app or desktop app work for you in the meantime, your notes should still be available there.

Hola, lamentamos que no puedas acceder a tu cuenta y que no te lleguen los correos de restablecimiento. Mientras tanto, revisa tu carpeta de spam o correo no deseado y confirma que usas la misma dirección de correo con la que te registraste. Nuestro equipo revisará tu cuenta y te ayudará a recuperar el acceso.
Thanks for the suggestion! We've passed your request for an Android widget on to our product team for consideration. We appreciate you helping us improve Lumen.

Thank you for the kind words and for checking before reorganizing your research notes. We'll confirm exactly how internal links behave when a note moves to another notebook, and what happens to comments and edit history when two notebooks are merged. Until then, you could try it on a couple of test notebooks with a few linked sample notes so your real data stays untouched.

Thank you for letting us know that your office has been getting Error 503 when opening Lumen since about 9:15 this morning. We have escalated this to our engineering team as a top priority and are investigating now. We will send you an update as soon as we have more information.

Thanks for reaching out, and good luck with your computer science degree! We're checking the current details of any student or education pricing for the Plus plan and will follow up with what's available and how to apply. In the meantime, you can keep using Lumen on your current plan.

Thanks for reporting both issues: the freezes when opening notebooks with more than 200 notes, and Ctrl+B sometimes inserting a literal 'b' in Lumen desktop for Windows. We've passed both to our team to investigate. If you can share your app version and Windows version, that will help us look into it.

Thanks for letting us know that images from your Evernote import are showing as broken icons. We're looking into what caused the attachments to break during import and will let you know whether re-linking or re-importing is the best way to restore them. In the meantime, please keep your original Evernote export file so nothing is lost.

Sorry you've been locked out and that your two-factor device and recovery codes aren't available. We've marked your request as high priority and will help you verify your identity so you can regain access to your notes. Please reply from the email address on your Lumen account so we can begin the account recovery process.

Thanks for letting us know, and sorry for the trouble. We're looking into why your two new teammates can't see the shared notebooks, and why your account still shows the free plan after the $48 Team upgrade charge. We'll follow up as soon as we have more information on both issues.
Sorry the app has been slow for you today. Could you tell us which device and version you're using, and whether the slowness happens with particular notes or actions? That will help us look into it.

Thanks for reporting this. We're sorry your coworkers get a 404 page when they open the share link lumen.example/s/ab12. We've passed this to our team to investigate and will follow up with you as soon as we know more.

Thank you for considering Lumen for your team, and for telling us that SAML single sign-on with Okta is a hard requirement for your security team. We have passed your request to our product team, and we can't share a timeline at this stage. Someone from our team will follow up with any information we're able to share as your evaluation continues.

Thanks for the suggestion! Alphabetical sorting for notes isn't available right now, so we've passed your request to our product team for consideration. We can't share a timeline, but feedback like yours helps shape what we build next.

Bonjour, merci pour votre message. Nous allons vous indiquer où modifier la carte bancaire associée à votre abonnement afin que vous puissiez la mettre à jour avant son expiration le mois prochain. N'hésitez pas à nous préciser si vous utilisez l'application web, de bureau ou mobile, pour que nous puissions vous guider plus précisément.

We're sorry to hear about the unexpected $480 charge and the overdraft it caused. We've flagged this as urgent and our billing team will review your account and the charge right away. We'll follow up with you as soon as we have more information.

Thanks for reporting this, and sorry that image uploads have been failing since this morning with the 'Upload failed, try again' message. We're looking into it. Could you tell us which device and app version you're using, plus the file type and size of a screenshot that fails?

Thanks for reaching out, and we're sorry to see you go. We'll confirm exactly what account deletion removes from Lumen, including your notes, notebooks and account details, and how the process and timing work. If you'd like to keep a copy of your notes, we recommend exporting them before the deletion goes ahead.

Thanks for reaching out! We'll send you step-by-step instructions for turning on offline mode, and we'll confirm whether it covers notebooks your teammates have shared with you. We'll also include the storage allowance for the Plus plan so you have everything in one place.

Thanks for reaching out, and we understand you need this template by end of day. We're checking the best way to set up a reusable standup template in Lumen and will send you clear steps shortly. In the meantime, keep your current standup note handy so it can serve as the starting point.

Thanks for flagging this. We understand how distracting it is to see 'Lumen' marked as a typo in your own notes, and we've passed it to our team to look into. In the meantime, you may be able to add the word to your spellcheck dictionary, usually by right-clicking it, so it's no longer underlined.

Thanks for reaching out! Using separate work and personal Lumen accounts on the same phone is a great way to keep things organized, and we'll confirm how that works on your device. Could you tell us whether you're on iOS or Android so we can send the right steps?
